BUSINESS OVERVIEW

ALLETE, Inc. is a Duluth, Minnesota-based utility holding company whose businesses include Minnesota Power, Superior Water, Light and Power, ALLETE Clean Energy, BNI Energy, New Energy Equity and other energy infrastructure interests.

Its regulated utility footprint is concentrated in Minnesota and Wisconsin, with clean-energy activities across North America. The take-private announced in May 2024 closed on December 15, 2025, and ALLETE survived as a privately held company under Alloy Parent LLC. CPP Investments owns 40% indirectly and Global Infrastructure Partners-managed vehicles own the remaining 60% indirectly, comprising GIP Fund V and the GIP-managed Tower Bridge vehicle. BlackRock is shown only as GIP's parent, not as a separate owner. Regulatory filings in 2026 describe a pending internal reorganization around Minnesota Power, not a completed ownership transfer. No later owner exit or signed platform sale was identified through August 23, 2026.

api.name: Bluepoint Wind
api.description: Bluepoint Wind, LLC is the holder of federal offshore-wind lease OCS-A 0537 in the New York Bight, approximately 38 nautical miles from New York and 53 nautical miles from New Jersey. The 71,522-acre lease supported a pre-construction concept of up to 2.4 GW but no generation facilities were constructed. Bluepoint Winds Holdings, LLC owns the leaseholder and is itself owned 50:50 by Ocean Winds through OW North America LLC and Global Infrastructure Partners through Seaway Energy Holdings, L.P. BlackRock is shown only as GIP's parent, while Mubadala's undisclosed participation remains within the GIP block. On April 27, 2026, the project parties signed a settlement that suspended lease duties and provides for cancellation after specified investment verification and reimbursement steps. BOEM still describes that cancellation as conditional; no final cancellation, ownership transfer or dissolution was identified through August 23, 2026, so both legal owner periods remain active.

milestones.event: Bluepoint and the U.S. Department of the Interior signed a settlement suspending lease duties and providing for future cancellation after specified verification and reimbursement steps; cancellation was not yet complete.

The federal offshore-wind lease for the Ocean Winds and Global Infrastructure Partners project became effective after their joint venture won the New York Bight auction; Bluepoint's parent remained owned 50:50 through OW North America and Seaway Energy Holdings.

api.subsector: Commercial and industrial distributed solar and solar-plus-storage
api.description: Lighthouse is a portfolio of 38 operating commercial-and-industrial distributed solar and solar-plus-storage projects totaling 89 MWDC across California, Colorado, Massachusetts, Minnesota, Vermont and Washington. The portfolio is asset-heavy and contracted, with operating renewable-generation and storage assets serving long-term commercial and industrial offtakers. BlackRock's Evergreen infrastructure strategy signed to acquire Lighthouse in November 2023 and the sale closed in December 2023. Excelsior Energy Capital sold 100% of its membership interests in the portfolio through Excelsior Renewable Energy Investment Fund I LP and disclosed the completed exit in March 2024. The transaction disclosure does not establish that BlackRock owns 100% of every project's total economic interests, so the current platform-level percentage is not inferred. Lighthouse is counted once as the manager-level portfolio; its 38 underlying project and SPV assets are not separate PortCos. No later portfolio sale, transfer or signed pending ownership transaction was identified through August 23, 2026.

api.description: National Renewable Solutions, LLC is a U.S. renewable-power developer and independent power producer that develops, finances, owns and operates utility-scale wind, solar and energy-storage projects. Current company materials report more than 3,000 MW in development, more than 1,200 MW commercialized and 190 MW owned and operated. NRS was founded in 2011 and is headquartered in Minnetonka, Minnesota. On August 18, 2021, NRS announced that BlackRock's Global Renewable Power strategy had recently completed a 100% acquisition; transaction counsel identifies GRP III Norse Holdings LP as the entry buyer. An August 2025 company release continued to identify NRS as owned by a BlackRock-managed fund, although the current exact stake and legal holding vehicle were not restated. BlackRock's acquisition of GIP did not create a separate NRS ownership period. No company-level sale or signed pending exit was identified through August 23, 2026.
